comments.en:
Who put wisdom in the hidden parts?
Who gave understanding to the mind?
comments.he: מִי־שָׁ֭ת בַּטֻּח֣וֹת חׇכְמָ֑ה א֤וֹ מִֽי־נָתַ֖ן לַשֶּׂ֣כְוִי בִינָֽה׃

sections.en: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who gives the rooster understanding to distinguish between day and night.
sections.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לַשֶּֽׂכְוִי בִינָה לְהַבְחִין בֵּין יוֹם וּבֵין לָֽיְלָה:
sections.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Morning Blessings 1

sections.en: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who did not make me a gentile.
sections.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם שֶׁלֹּא עָשַֽׂנִי גּוֹי:
sections.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Morning Blessings 2

sections.en: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who did not make me a slave.
sections.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם שֶׁלֹּא עָשַֽׂנִי עָֽבֶד:
sections.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Morning Blessings 3

sections.en: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who did not make me a woman.
sections.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם שֶׁלֹּא עָשַֽׂנִי אִשָּׁה:
sections.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Morning Blessings 4

sections.en: (A woman says: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who made me according to His will.)
sections.he: (<small>נשים אומרות:</small> בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם שֶׁעָשַֽׂנִי כִּרְצוֹנוֹ:)
sections.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Morning Blessings 5

comments.en: And the L<small>ORD</small> God made garments of skins for Adam and his wife, and clothed them.
comments.he: וַיַּ֩עַשׂ֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֜ים לְאָדָ֧ם וּלְאִשְׁתּ֛וֹ כׇּתְנ֥וֹת ע֖וֹר וַיַּלְבִּשֵֽׁם׃ {פ}

sections.en: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who gives sight to the blind.
sections.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם פּוֹקֵֽחַ עִוְרִים:
sections.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Morning Blessings 6

sections.en: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who clothes the naked.
sections.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם מַלְבִּישׁ עֲרֻמִּים:
sections.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Morning Blessings 7

sections.en: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who releases the imprisoned.
sections.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם מַתִּיר אֲסוּרִים:
sections.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Morning Blessings 8

sections.en: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who straightens the bent.
sections.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם זוֹקֵף כְּפוּפִים:
sections.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Morning Blessings 9

comments.en:
Who spread the earth over the water,
His steadfast love is eternal;
comments.he: לְרֹקַ֣ע הָ֭אָרֶץ עַל־הַמָּ֑יִם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

sections.en: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who spreads the earth above the waters.
sections.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם רוֹקַע הָאָֽרֶץ עַל הַמָּֽיִם:
sections.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Morning Blessings 10

sections.en: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who provided me with all my needs.
sections.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם שֶׁעָשָׂה לִי כָּל־צָרְכִּי:
sections.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Morning Blessings 11

sections.en: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who prepares the steps of man.
sections.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם הַמֵּכִין מִצְעֲדֵי גָֽבֶר:
sections.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Morning Blessings 12

sections.en: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who girds Israel with might.
sections.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אוֹזֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּגְבוּרָה:
sections.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Morning Blessings 13

sections.en: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who crowns Israel with glory.
sections.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם עוֹטֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּתִפְאָרָה:
sections.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Morning Blessings 14

comments.en:
He gives strength to the weary,
Fresh vigor to the spent.
comments.he: נֹתֵ֥ן לַיָּעֵ֖ף כֹּ֑חַ וּלְאֵ֥ין אוֹנִ֖ים עׇצְמָ֥ה יַרְבֶּֽה׃

sections.en: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who gives strength to the weary.
sections.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם הַנּוֹתֵן לַיָּעֵף כֹּֽחַ:
sections.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Morning Blessings 15

comments.en:
Give your eyes no sleep,
Your pupils no slumber.

sections.en: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who removes sleep from my eyes and slumber from my eyelids.
sections.he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם הַמַּעֲבִיר שֵׁנָה מֵעֵינָי וּתְנוּמָה מֵעַפְעַפָּי:
sections.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Morning Blessings 16

sections.en: And may it be Your will Adonoy, our God And God of our fathers, to make us study Torah regularly, and hold fast to Your commandments. Do not bring us into the grasp of sin, nor into the grasp of transgression or iniquity. Do not cause us to be tested, or brought to disgrace. Let us not be ruled over by the Evil Inclination. Keep us far from an evil person, and from an evil companion. Make us hold fast to the Good Inclination, and to good deeds, and compel our Evil Inclination to be subservient to You. Grant us this day and every day favor, kindness, and compassion in Your eyes and in the eyes of all who see us, and bestow bountiful kindness upon us, Blessed are You, Adonoy, Who bestows bountiful kindness upon His people Israel.
sections.he: וִיהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ שֶׁתַּרְגִּילֵֽנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ וְדַבְּקֵֽנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ, וְאַל תְּבִיאֵֽנוּ לֹא לִידֵי חֵטְא וְלֹא לִידֵי עֲבֵרָה וְעָוֹן וְלֹא לִידֵי נִסָּיוֹן וְלֹא לִידֵי בִזָּיוֹן וְאַל יִשְׁלֹט בָּֽנוּ יֵֽצֶר הָרָע וְהַרְחִיקֵֽנוּ מֵאָדָם רָע וּמֵחָבֵר רָע וְדַבְּקֵֽנוּ בְּיֵֽצֶר הַטּוֹב וּבְמַעֲשִׂים טוֹבִים וְכוֹף אֶת־יִצְרֵֽנוּ לְהִשְׁתַּעְבֶּד־לָךְ וּתְנֵֽנוּ הַיּוֹם וּבְכָל־יוֹם לְחֵן וּלְחֶֽסֶד וּלְרַחֲמִים בְּעֵינֶֽיךָ וּבְעֵינֵי כָל־רוֹאֵֽינוּ וְתִגְמְלֵֽנוּ חֲסָדִים טוֹבִים: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה גּוֹמֵל חֲסָדִים טוֹבִים לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל:
sections.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Morning Blessings 17

sections.en: May it be Your will, Adonoy, my God and God of my fathers, to save me today and every day from arrogant men and from arrogance; from an evil man, from an evil companion, from an evil neighbor; from an evil mishap and from the destructive Satan; from a difficult judgment and a difficult opponent, whether he is a [fellow Jew] or not a [fellow Jew].
sections.he: יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהַי וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתַי שֶׁתַּצִּילֵֽנִי הַיּוֹם וּבְכָל־יוֹם מֵעַזֵּי פָנִים וּמֵעַזּוּת פָּנִים מֵאָדָם רָע וּמֵחָבֵר רָע וּמִשָּׁכֵן רָע וּמִפֶּֽגַע רָע וּמִשָּׂטָן הַמַּשְׁחִית מִדִּין קָשֶׁה וּמִבַּֽעַל דִּין קָשֶׁה, בֵּין שֶׁהוּא בֶן בְּרִית וּבֵין שֶׁאֵינוֹ בֶן בְּרִית:
sections.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Preparatory Prayers, Morning Blessings 18
